title: Sable and the Vow
author: Zephyrine Ravensworth
blurb: Vesper Dunmore, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
